unit.title: Managing a Successful Business Project (Pearson Set)

criteria.criterion_text: Explain the stages of the project lifecycle (PLC) and their importance to the success of a project
Examine the factors to be considered when compiling a project management plan (PMP)
Examine a range of research methods and strategies and their importance for gathering information and data collection
Produce a PMP that covers, aim, objectives, deliverables, quality, risk, communication resources and research methods
Produce a work breakdown structure and a schedule to provide timeframes and stages for completion
Conduct a business project as stated within the PMP and communicate findings
Present data to draw valid and meaningful conclusions and recommendations from data analysis
Reflect on the value of undertaking the business project to meet stated objectives and own learning and performance
Evaluate the stages of the PLC and the factors, (deliverables, quality, risk, communication and resources) to be considered in a PMP
Evaluate a range of research methods and strategies for gathering information and data collection
Produce a detailed PMP, and schedule for monitoring and completing the aims and objectives of the project
Justify conclusions and recommendations drawn from data analysis and findings to meet the stated project objectives
Evaluate the project management process to meet stated objectives and support own learning and performance
Justify the choices made in the design of the PMP for completing the aims and objectives of the project
Critically reflect on the findings from the research and the project management process in supporting stated objectives and own learning
